what: a smooth loft through circles r20, r10, r20 at z = 0, 20, 40
method: three sections loft smooth at degree 2 (crates/kernel/src/smlib_sweeps.rs, loft: ruled from two, quadratic from three), through equally spaced, concentric circles: every row of control points is interpolated by the same quadratic in the loft parameter, so each section of the loft is a circle, r(z) = 10 + (z - 20)^2 / 40 (the quadratic through r 20, 10, 20 at z 0, 20, 40; z is linear in the parameter). V = pi int r^2 dz = 22400 pi / 3; A = 2 pi 20^2 + 2 pi int r sqrt(1 + r'^2) dz (Gauss, exact on the polynomial volume). Faces: two disks and the lofted face; edges: the two circles and the seam; vertices: one on each circle. Centre of mass (0, 0, 20) by symmetry; bbox: r <= 20 (the quadratic's maximum is at the ends)
